newsitem.title: USA: RLI to buy back stock, redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: RLI to buy back stock, redeem debentures.

text.p: RLI Corp said Friday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 1.8 million shares of common stock, and also called for redemption its six percent convertible debentures that mature July 15, 2003.
RLI, which underwrites property and casualty insurance, said the stock repurchase is expected to begin after July 21 and will be made from time to time depending on market conditions.

RLI said its $46 million bond issue will be redeemed for cash on July 22, 1997, at 103 percent of its principal amount, plus accrued interest. A regular interest payment on the debentures will be paid July 15 to holders of record as of June 30.

Holders of the debentures may elect to convert, at any time prior to the close of business July 21, debentures at a rate of 38.4615 shares of common stock for each $1,000 principal amount of convertible debentures.
